title: Bayesian optimisation finds cell-type-specific micelle formulations for mRNA delivery
summary: Closed-loop multi-objective Bayesian optimisation (qNEHVI) over three rounds in HEK293T cells identified a ternary A7/CEA/PEG-CEA region that raised effective efficiency (delivery x viability) from about 0.35 for the A7 homomicelle to about 0.8 for the best mixed micelle. The resulting 35-formulation library was screened in six more cell types, including primary patient-derived fibroblasts, where the best mixed micelle outperformed all polymer-based commercial reagents in every cell line. In vitro work only.
